spell.arcanes_oublies.clockwork_sawblade: Fling a ring of steel teeth spinning round brass gears and a blue core: it cuts through four enemies and breaks into cogs where it stops.
spell.arcanes_oublies.rivet_volley.guide: Fire a fan of red-hot rivets, steam trailing behind them; each strikes the first enemy in its way.
spell.arcanes_oublies.mainspring_leap.gu: A great coiled spring rises under you, crushes down and lets go, flinging you high and ahead and knocking back the enemies round it; where you land, a stomp of gears strikes all round. You take no fall damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.gear_trap.guide: Set a trap of brass and steel on the ground where you aim. Its jaws snap shut on the first enemies to step in, biting them and holding them where they stand for three seconds.
spell.arcanes_oublies.clockwork_turret.g: A brass turret unfolds on its tripod where you aim and, for ten seconds, fires its spinning barrels at the nearest enemy it can see.
spell.arcanes_oublies.gyro_cage.guide: Three toothed rings close round the enemy you look at, tumbling round it on their own axles: it is held in their middle and struck by arcs every half second, and when the rings burst apart it takes a last heavy blow.
spell.arcanes_oublies.brass_automaton.gu: A walking machine of brass and copper near three blocks tall rises before you in a burst of steam and fights for you for twenty seconds: it strides to the nearest enemy, winds back its piston arm and punches, flinging what it hits. With no enemy near, it keeps by you.
spell.arcanes_oublies.brass_locomotive.g: Rails lay themselves down beside you and far ahead in a line of blue light, then a red and brass steam engine charges down them, flinging aside every enemy on the track, and bursts into steam at its end.
spell.arcanes_oublies.airship_bombardmen: An airship of canvas and brass flies over the ground you aim at, dropping a string of ten bombs that burst in fire and smoke.
spell.arcanes_oublies.great_mechanism.gu: Wind the world's clockwork. A great gear turns under you, a toothed ring of brass runs round the field, eight great gears rise round it with pistons pumping steam between them, and high above an astrolabe of tumbling rings spins round a core of blue energy. Every half second the core hurls an arc at an enemy, your side is hardened and your enemies slowed; then the core overloads in a wave of blue light that strikes every enemy in the field, flings it away and shields your side.
spell.arcanes_oublies.mana_salamander.gu: Summon a salamander of red mana, embers glowing in its veins. Its bite sets your enemies on fire, and when they come close it breathes a gout of flame over them; fire cannot hurt it. Cast again to send it away.
ui.arcanes_oublies.bite_burns: Bite Sets on Fire for %s s
spell.arcanes_oublies.mana_tiger.guide: Summon a great tiger of mana, its stripes glowing from within. It stalks your enemies and pounces on them from afar with a roar (a heavy blow that leaves them slowed), then rakes them with its claws.

spell.arcanes_oublies.note_volley.guide: Throw three notes of gold (more as you grow stronger); each bends toward the enemy most ahead of it and bursts into little notes where it strikes.
spell.arcanes_oublies.staff_slash.guide: Sweep a staff of five lines of light round in front of you like a blade, notes riding on it: it strikes every enemy within its reach and pushes them back.
spell.arcanes_oublies.soothing_melody.gu: A gentle tune plays round you for five seconds, a staff of light turning at your feet: every second it heals you and your allies near you, and draws out poison and wither.
spell.arcanes_oublies.crescendo.guide: Send rings of sound rolling out from your hand. They grow wider and louder as they go, and strike harder and push further the longer they have travelled.
spell.arcanes_oublies.lullaby.guide: A treble clef of gold rises over the place you point at and a soft tune falls with its notes: enemies there fall asleep, standing still with their weapons lowered, until a blow wakes them or they are carried out of the song's reach.
spell.arcanes_oublies.war_drum.guide: A great war drum appears beside you and two mallets of gold beat it in turn. Each beat strikes the enemies round it with a ring of sound and gives your side strength and speed.
spell.arcanes_oublies.harp_of_light.guid: A harp of gold floats over your shoulder for eight seconds; its strings of light are plucked one by one, and each note flies as a ray at the nearest enemy it can see.
spell.arcanes_oublies.phantom_trumpets.g: Five trumpets of gold rise in an arc behind you and sound a fanfare three times. Each blast is a wall of sound that strikes the enemies before you and hurls them back.
spell.arcanes_oublies.storm_organ.guide: A great organ of gold pipes rises where you point, a clef at its crown. It plays, and each chord calls a pillar of light down on an enemy near it; then it sounds its last great chord, which strikes every enemy round it and flings them away.
Conduct. Eight violins appear in a ring round you and play, staves of light wheel round the field, a great clef of gold turns overhead. Notes fall on your enemies, your side is healed, quickened and strengthened while your enemies are slowed; then the orchestra plays its finale, a chord that strikes every enemy in the field, flings them away and shields your side.

spell.arcanes_oublies.lifethread.guide: Tie a thread of golden light from your hand to the ally you look at (or yourself). While it holds, up to 16 blocks, it heals them every half second for six seconds; stray too far and it snaps.
spell.arcanes_oublies.suture.guide: Stitch shut one ally's wounds with threads of light: the deeper they are hurt, the more it heals, up to twice as much at the brink.
spell.arcanes_oublies.echo_heal.guide: Heal one ally, and the healing echoes twice, two and four seconds later, each echo half the last.
spell.arcanes_oublies.purge.guide: Draw every ailment out of one ally in a flash of white light, and heal them for each one taken.
spell.arcanes_oublies.mending_bud.guide: Lay a bud of rose light over one ally for twenty seconds. When they fall below half their health it blooms: a burst of healing, and more after.
spell.arcanes_oublies.guardian_wisp.guid: A wisp of green light circles one ally and answers each wound they take: half of it is healed a moment later.
spell.arcanes_oublies.blood_pact.guide: Give some of your own life to the ally you look at: they are healed three times what it cost you. It never takes your last heart.
spell.arcanes_oublies.rewind.guide: Wind one ally's wounds back like a clock: their health becomes the most it was in the last five seconds.
spell.arcanes_oublies.cocoon.guide: Wind one ally in a cocoon of turning light for three seconds: no harm reaches them and they heal all the while, but they cannot move.
spell.arcanes_oublies.second_life.guide: Set a halo of gold over one ally. If they would die while it shines, they rise again at half their health, cleansed, shielded and healing.
spell.arcanes_oublies.bramble_snare.guid: Hide a snare of poisoned brambles where you aim. The first enemy to step in is poisoned and slowed.
spell.arcanes_oublies.hex_glyph.guide: Draw a glyph of weakness on the ground where you aim. The first enemy to step on it is weakened and its blows slowed.
spell.arcanes_oublies.bloodletter.guide: Hide a ring of iron spikes on the ground. The first enemy to step in bleeds.
spell.arcanes_oublies.soot_mine.guide: Bury a mine of soot. When an enemy steps on it, a black cloud blinds every enemy near and marks them so they glow through walls.
spell.arcanes_oublies.rust_jaw.guide: Set a jaw trap of rusted iron. Its bite leaves the enemy's armour rusting and sundered.
spell.arcanes_oublies.echo_trap.guide: A trap that springs again and again, on every enemy that crosses it, five times in all; each time it catches the same enemy, its slowness and weakness grow a step, up to III.
spell.arcanes_oublies.plague_carrier.gui: The first enemy to step in is poisoned and starved, and for eight seconds carries the plague to every enemy near them.
spell.arcanes_oublies.leech_trap.guide: A leech of blood waits on the ground. It withers the first enemy to step in and, while they wither, feeds your health.
spell.arcanes_oublies.minefield.guide: Scatter seven mines round the place you point at, each laying its own curse: poison, slowness, weakness, withering, blindness, bleeding, sundered armour.
spell.arcanes_oublies.cursed_web.guide: Spread a great web of curses over the ground where you point. Every two seconds each enemy in it falls under a new curse, in turn.
